name: ra_gal
description: Galaxy right ascension.
notes: ICRS-like sky coordinate used for spatial selection.

name: dec_gal
description: Galaxy declination.
notes: ICRS-like sky coordinate used for spatial selection.

name: ra_mag_gal
description: Right ascension associated with the photometry/magnitude position.

name: dec_mag_gal
description: Declination associated with the photometry/magnitude position.

name: z_true
description: True halo redshift, aliased by the download query.
notes: Used only for diagnostics in the default workflow.

name: z_phz
description: First mode of the photometric-redshift probability distribution.
notes: Used as fixed DSPS z_obs by the default config.

name: z_true_gal
description: True galaxy redshift.
notes: Preferred truth redshift for galaxy-level DSPS validation.

name: z_obs_gal
description: Observed galaxy redshift including peculiar velocity.

name: z_deepz
description: DeepZ mode of the p(z) distribution.

name: redshift_step
description: Redshift step from the Flagship DM lensing healpix maps.

name: phz_flags
description: NNPZ photometric-redshift quality flag.
notes: 0 means no known issue; 1 means insufficient neighbours for robust photo-z.

name: phz_median
description: NNPZ median of the photometric-redshift PDF.
notes: Used as the default DSPS redshift estimate in the updated configs.

name: phz_min_70
description: Lower edge of the NNPZ 70 percent PDF interval.

name: phz_max_70
description: Upper edge of the NNPZ 70 percent PDF interval.

name: phz_min_90
description: Lower edge of the NNPZ 90 percent PDF interval.

name: phz_max_90
description: Upper edge of the NNPZ 90 percent PDF interval.

name: phz_min_95
description: Lower edge of the NNPZ 95 percent PDF interval.

name: phz_max_95
description: Upper edge of the NNPZ 95 percent PDF interval.

name: phz_mode_1_area
description: Total PDF area of the first NNPZ photo-z mode.

name: phz_mode_2
description: Second mode of the NNPZ photo-z PDF when present.

name: phz_mode_2_area
description: Total PDF area of the second NNPZ photo-z mode.

name: sed_cosmos_1
description: Primary COSMOS SED template identifier in the COSMOS_MOD.list order.
notes: ID range is 0--30 for the 31 local LePhare COSMOS templates.

name: sed_cosmos_2
description: Secondary COSMOS SED template identifier in the COSMOS_MOD.list order.
notes: Used for two-component COSMOS proxy SED reconstruction.

name: frac_cosmos_1
description: Fractional contribution of COSMOS SED component 1.
notes: Optional in current local parquet. If absent, the configured reconstruction policy is explicit.

name: frac_cosmos_2
description: Fractional contribution of COSMOS SED component 2.
notes: Optional in current local parquet. Fractions are normalized internally when their finite sum is positive.

name: color_kind
description: HOD-based color class: 0 red sequence, 1 green valley, 2 blue cloud.
notes: Used for grouped COSMOS-vs-DSPS diagnostics.

name: euclid_vis
description: Simulated Euclid VIS flux density.
notes: Project config interprets this as Fnu in cgs units.

name: euclid_nisp_y
description: Simulated Euclid NISP Y-band flux density.

name: euclid_nisp_j
description: Simulated Euclid NISP J-band flux density.

name: euclid_nisp_h
description: Simulated Euclid NISP H-band flux density.

name: euclid_vis_abs
unit: erg s^-1 cm^-2 Hz^-1 at 10 pc
description: Rest-frame Euclid VIS flux density at 10 parsec.
notes: Optional CosmoHub tooltip column used for pseudo-SED anchoring.

name: euclid_nisp_y_abs
unit: erg s^-1 cm^-2 Hz^-1 at 10 pc
description: Rest-frame Euclid NISP Y-band flux density at 10 parsec.
notes: Optional CosmoHub tooltip column used for pseudo-SED anchoring.

name: euclid_nisp_j_abs
unit: erg s^-1 cm^-2 Hz^-1 at 10 pc
description: Rest-frame Euclid NISP J-band flux density at 10 parsec.
notes: Optional CosmoHub tooltip column used for pseudo-SED anchoring.

name: euclid_nisp_h_abs
unit: erg s^-1 cm^-2 Hz^-1 at 10 pc
description: Rest-frame Euclid NISP H-band flux density at 10 parsec.
notes: Optional CosmoHub tooltip column used for pseudo-SED anchoring.

name: euclid_vis_el_model3_ext
description: Euclid VIS flux including emission lines and internal attenuation.
notes: Branch-2 target set B.

name: euclid_vis_el_model3_ext_odonnell_ext
description: Euclid VIS flux including emission lines, internal attenuation, and Milky Way extinction.
notes: Branch-2 target set C.

name: euclid_vis_el_model3_ext_odonnell_ext_error
description: Flux uncertainty for the Euclid VIS Milky-Way-extincted flux.
notes: Used for chi-square in branch-2 target set D.

name: euclid_vis_el_model3_ext_odonnell_ext_error_realization
description: Noisy realization of the Euclid VIS Milky-Way-extincted flux.
notes: Branch-2 target set D.

name: lsst_u
description: Simulated LSST u-band flux density.

name: lsst_g
description: Simulated LSST g-band flux density.

name: lsst_r
description: Simulated LSST r-band flux density.

name: lsst_i
description: Simulated LSST i-band flux density.

name: lsst_z
description: Simulated LSST z-band flux density.

name: lsst_y
description: Simulated LSST y-band flux density.

name: log_stellar_mass
description: Base-10 logarithm of catalog stellar mass.
notes: Convert to log10(Msun) as log_stellar_mass + 2 log10(h).

name: log_ml_r01
description: Logarithm of stellar-mass-to-luminosity ratio in SDSS 0.1-r band.

name: abs_mag_r01
description: Absolute magnitude in the SDSS 0.1-r band in h=1 units.

name: log_luminosity_r01
description: Base-10 luminosity in the SDSS 0.1-r band.

name: abs_mag_uv_unextincted
description: Unextincted absolute magnitude in a broad ultraviolet filter near 1800 A.
notes: Useful diagnostic for dust/SFR failures, not a direct DSPS fit target.

name: metallicity_true
description: Gas-phase oxygen abundance, aliased by the download query.
notes: Reports convert to log10 metallicity proxy with offset -10.61.

name: log_sfr_true
description: Base-10 logarithm of catalog star-formation rate.

name: sfr_true
description: Linear star-formation rate computed by the download query.

name: ebv_cosmos_2
description: COSMOS E(B-V) component 2.

name: ext_curve_cosmos_1

name: ext_curve_cosmos_2
description: Extinction-curve identifier for dust component 2.

name: mw_extinction
description: Milky Way foreground extinction scalar.

name: dust_ebv_true
description: Single intrinsic E(B-V) target computed by the download query.
notes: Bulge-fraction weighted when both COSMOS dust components are present.

name: bulge_fraction

name: bulge_r50
description: Bulge half-light radius.

name: eps2_gal

description: Bulge ellipticity.

name: disk_nsersic
description: Disk Sersic index.
